Bibliographical note
The Report has drawn on a wide range of World Bank
reports and advice and on numerous outside sources.
Special thanks go to the World Health Organization
(WHO) for providing extensive expert advice, techni-
cal materials, and helpful comments.
The principal sources are noted below and are also
listed alphabetically by author or organization in two
groups: background papers commissioned for this
Report and a selected bibliography.
In addition to the sources listed, many people both
inside and outside the World Bank helped with the
Report. In particular, helpful comments were re-
ceived from World Bank staff and consultants, includ-
ing Alexandre Abrantes, Masood Ahmed, Michael
Azefor, Howard Barnum, Alan Berg, Eduard Bos, Pa-
